definition: The AI Seoul Summit 2024 was an event in May 2024 co-hosted by the South Korean and British governments.
details: The Seoul Declaration was adopted to address artificial intelligence technology and related challenges and opportunities.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Think of it as the quiet rule that a tool should be useful without being dangerous. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” And that is AI Seoul Summit 2024 — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
